title: Band: drums, bass, strummed guitar, lead line (singer stand-in)
what: Synthesized band, D major, 116 BPM: one silent bar, one side-stick count-in bar, then 16 bars of drums (channel 10), electric bass (GM program 33), strummed steel guitar (program 25), lead line on Voice Oohs (program 53) standing in for a singer. Mix plus each stem alone under stems/.
